_comment: Step-0 curation pins for the web demo (docs/PLAN-webui-demo-fbf243.md §3.1).
Human-authored candidate set the selector ranks WITHIN — not inferred by a script.
Best-per-game by BvH (champion==bvh aggregate_pct), except Othello (Edax, BvH saturated)
and TTT (solved, no sweep CSV). Board variant is read from each save header (game/board/win_length).
KEY FINDING (amends the plan): the strong Hex/Gomoku nets are the alphazero-cnn topology
whose .sav is ~87% embedded replay buffer that the web loader NEVER reads (web/wasm_load.cpp:269
breaks at the 'replay_buffer' line). build-demo-bundle.sh must STRIP the replay buffer
(truncate at the marker; no-op if absent) BEFORE zstd. Sizes below are decimal MB (x1,000,000, matching capRawMB/capZstMB).
and Gomoku 11x11 269MB->37MB raw / 11.7MB zst, both under the 50MB-raw / 15MB-zst caps — so the demo
showcases the 99.5%/100%-BvH flagship nets on real board sizes instead of the weak size-viable ones
(Hex 11x11 non-cnn = 1.5% BvH; Gomoku 11x11 non-cnn = 37%). Stripped-save load MUST be verified in
the Phase-9 headless harness (game-type + board-variant + one move) — the new risk this introduces.

pipeline.stripNote: Copy out only the sections the web loader reads: truncate at the 'replay_buffer' marker line, excise the interior cnn_adam_state block, AND (since 2026-09-06) excise the interior cnn_champion_pool block whenever a complete cnn_ema_parameters block is present (grep -aob for the markers; each part no-ops when its marker is absent). Loader builds the net from EMA>champion>learner (wasm_load.cpp:289-294), all of which precede the buffer; its section loop never recognises cnn_adam_state, and with an EMA present it parses the pool but never uses it. The pool grows by one net per online retention stage (26MB after C1-5's six, 52MB after C5 Arm A's twelve), which is what pushed the Arm A re-pin over the raw cap. A save WITHOUT an EMA keeps its pool.

ttt.label: Tic-Tac-Toe
ttt.note: 30M-cycle NEAT champion the dev app ships; only canonical is already .zst (no raw ttt.sav) -> copy through, verify zstd -t. Documented BvH exception (no ttt-*-sweep.csv). Heuristic opponent N/A (supportsHeuristic:false) -> matchup is Human-vs-Model / Model-vs-Model only.

connect4.label: Connect 4
connect4.note: Single 7x6/w4 board (heuristic era stable for C4). 99.0% BvH at 13MB raw -> ~1MB zst, no strip strictly needed but strip is a harmless no-cost shrink. Ties at 99.0%: connect4-alphazero-tsim400-sims400 (equal). The 100% cnn4x32-policy net exists but is 115MB and needs stripping for no BvH gain over 99.0% -> not chosen. Excluded stronger-but-larger: connect4-alphazero-rc500k-* (99.5% @ 48.7MB).

othello.label: Othello
othello.strategy: ALPHAZERO_CNN 7x64 (C5 Arm A: the certified champion + a 2nd online generation; deployed by policy override 2026-09-06)
othello.note: BvH saturated for Othello (net beats ply-8 heuristic) -> ranked on the Edax ladder. DEPLOYED BY POLICY OVERRIDE, NOT CERTIFIED (docs/HANDOFF-othello-program.md section 6; analysis in docs/BRAINSTORM-othello-next-avenues.md section 8). Its C5 ship read (docs/BRIEF-c5-gen2-capacity.md section 10) was INCONCLUSIVE: +0.037 [+0.0216, +0.0527] pooled L9/L10 score at s12800 over the certified champion othello-c15-seed11 (CI excludes zero; lower bound below the S=0.025 bar); dev +0.047 [+0.034, +0.059] IMPROVES. edaxScoreVsL10 = 0.680 is a DESCRIPTIVE read (256/32/112, n=400, the spent dev-select-topup slice, eval seed 5, cpuct 2.5; the champion scored 0.6425 on the same cells in C4) and NOT a ship number. 160MB raw; post-strip 12.95MB raw / 4.78MB zst (measured 2026-09-06) — it fits ONLY because the strip now excises its 52MB champion pool (twelve retention stages' worth) alongside cnn_adam_state and the buffer; without the pool strip it was 64.9MB raw, over the cap. The certified champion othello-c15-seed11.sav remains the fallback pin. DO NOT bundle othello-az-cnn7x64-edaxopp-L6 (~207MB, weaker).

hex.label: Hex
hex.note: Tournament-standard 11x11. Only board with a strong (99.5% BvH) net that is size-viable AFTER stripping (280MB->36MB raw / 11.4MB zst with the buffer+Adam strip; ->5.3MB raw / 1.9MB zst since the champion-pool strip of 2026-09-06, same played net: the EMA). Size-viable non-cnn 11x11 nets are unusable (1.5% BvH). 9x9 cnn is stronger-board but the nets are 180-370MB (bigger even stripped). REQUIRES the strip pipeline step.

gomoku.label: Gomoku
gomoku.note: 11x11 win-5 (freestyle). 100% BvH cnn5x48 stripped 269MB->37MB raw / 11.7MB zst with the buffer+Adam strip; ->5.5MB raw / 1.9MB zst since the champion-pool strip of 2026-09-06 (same played net: the EMA). Alt with equal BvH: -cnn5x48-ply4cont (same size; both saturate BvH at 100% so BvH can't separate them — base run chosen as canonical). 13x13 has only a 233MB cnn8x96 PBT champion at 97.4% (s100/ply3, different regime); 15x15 has no viable net. REQUIRES the strip pipeline step.
